name: A Frayed Doll: Yuri Visual Novel
source:
Bobby recently was dumped by an ex and cannot get over it! It's up to you to be her right hand (or her left hand) and emotionally guide her through these next three (or more) days in a peculiar plush vessel.

[From [url=https://drewblossom.itch.io/a-frayed-doll-yuri-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
鲍比最近被前任甩了，无法释怀！你可以成为她的右手（或左手），在一个特殊的毛绒容器中情感地引导她度过接下来的三天（或更多）天。

[来自[url=https://drewblossom.itch.io/a-frayed-doll-yuri-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
